# Test fixture licences and sources

The files in this directory are test fixtures. They may have licences or
copyright statuses separate from the main project licence.

## testing.pdf

Source: [WikiSource](https://en.wikisource.org/wiki/A_Letter_Concerning_Toleration)
Description: Part of a book used as a PDF test fixture.
Licence: CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication

Notes:
Used only as an unmodified test fixture. Generated derivative outputs from this
file should not be committed or distributed as public CI artefacts.

## Hobbes_1651_Leviathan.pdf

Source: [Internet Archive](https://archive.org/details/hobbessleviathan00hobbuoft)
Description: PDF scan of Thomas Hobbes, Leviathan; stated publication date 1909.
Rights/status: Believed to be public domain in the United States due to age,
but Internet Archive does not guarantee item copyright status.

Notes:
The source item should be checked for its Internet Archive metadata, including
any rights, licence, uploader, and collection information. This repository records
the file as a public-domain historical scan to the best of our knowledge.
